byline: By Justin Bank. Edited by Andy Pergam, Knight Center for the Future of News

figures.name: Pressures timeline
figures.label: Figure 1: Funding and organization timeline, 2018–2026
figures.precedes: The pattern is the same across every failure
figures.caption: Selected funding shocks to American journalism, 2018–2026: events we could date from a primary or major-outlet source, not a complete list. Dollar figures appear only where documented; tags show the cohorts each shock hit hardest.
figures.source: Sources: company announcements, congressional record, CPB, news reports, 2018–2026.

figures.name: Nine-cohort card grid
figures.label: Figure 2: The nine cohorts
figures.follows: Worker-Owned Co-ops, Emerging Civic Actors and B2B/Professional Services
figures.caption: Nine cohorts, defined by how an organization is governed and funded. Examples are organizations in the dataset (169 in all); each card carries one tension.
figures.source: Source: Nodes and Networks dataset, n=169.

figures.name: Defector revenue and revenue per subscriber
figures.label: Figure 3: Defector revenue, Years 1–5
figures.caption: Defector's revenue by September-to-August year, 2020–21 to 2024–25, split into subscription revenue and all other revenue, from its annual reports. Subscription revenue was flat at $3.8M in 2023–24 and 2024–25.
figures.source: Source: Defector annual reports, Years 1–5. Defector describes its figures as stylized approximations of its P&L.

figures.name: Grant dependency lollipop
figures.label: Figure 4: Share of revenue from grants and donations, nonprofit newsrooms with $3.5M–$10M in revenue (17 organizations)
figures.follows: No organization in this dataset sits above $10 million in revenue
figures.precedes: Track the same organizations for three years
figures.caption: Share of revenue from grants and donations, nonprofits with $3.5 million to $10 million in revenue whose filings we could break down (n=17). 15 are above 80%.
figures.source: Source: most recent IRS Form 990 filings.

figures.name: Band position by cohort (stacked bar)
figures.label: Figure 5: Revenue band distribution by cohort (n=169)
figures.follows: That’s a story about fragility in one part of the map
figures.caption: Share of organizations in each cohort by annual revenue (n=169). Every legacy publisher sits above $10 million. No worker co-op or civic actor does, and most sit below $3.5 million. Philanthropic newsrooms spread across all three.
figures.source: Source: Nodes and Networks dataset, n=169.
